verdict.rationale: Secureframe's API/custom integrations feature lets users create and map custom resources, push raw data for testing, and normalize compliance-related resources (docs-2, docs-3, docs-22, docs-36), which implies some ability to define custom tests/evidence outside native integrations. However, there is no explicit documentation of adding a full custom 'framework' object alongside built-in frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.) or defining custom controls with their own evidence requirements in the same structured way as native frameworks. Missing for 10: explicit custom framework creation UI/API, mapping of custom controls to a control library, and evidence of custom evidence-requirement definitions tied to those controls.
